curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: recommend reading for enjoyment and information.

mission.title: recommend reading for enjoyment and information.

interactions.prompt: Which book would you recommend to a friend who wants a funny story?
interactions.feedback: Yes! A funny storybook can be read for enjoyment.
interactions.retryHint: Choose the book meant to make a reader smile.

interactions.prompt: Which text can help you learn what a lion eats?
interactions.feedback: Correct! A fact book gives information.
interactions.retryHint: Look for the text that teaches facts about animals.

interactions.prompt: Amina enjoys adventures. What should you recommend?
interactions.feedback: Great recommendation! It matches Amina's interest.
interactions.retryHint: Choose the text with an exciting journey.

interactions.prompt: Jabali wants to know how seeds grow. Which reading will help most?
interactions.feedback: Well done! The information book matches his question.
interactions.retryHint: Choose the book that teaches about plants.

interactions.prompt: Which recommendation gives both a reason and the book's purpose?
interactions.feedback: Excellent! A useful recommendation names a text and explains why.
interactions.retryHint: Choose the message that says what to read and why.

interactions.prompt: Why should we recommend reading to others?
interactions.feedback: Exactly! Reading can delight us and help us learn.
interactions.retryHint: Think about the two purposes: enjoyment and information.
